title: FluidAudio 0.18.0 adds on-device speech models
summary: FluidAudio 0.18.0 ships new Core ML speech models for Apple platforms, including Nemotron Unified ASR for 25 European languages, a Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Lite encoder with speaker labels, Bark 3.0, and Canary translation between English and 24 European languages.

appearances.title: FluidAudio runs Pocket TTS and Phonon text-to-speech on the Apple Neural Engine
appearances.summary: FluidAudio ported the 18M, 7M and 2M Pocket TTS models and Gradium's Phonon 31M to CoreML with the flow model on the Neural Engine. On an M5 Pro the author reports 24x to 51x real time, about 25 ms to first audio and under 110 MB of memory, so apps can ship fast offline speech on Macs and iPhones.
